title: mut.feedback
mutation_directive: STRONGER COLOR REIN-IN than the earlier note (which already said -25-40% lightness, -30% saturation). User repeated 2026-05-07: 'oversaturated, fix that.' Pull the palette FURTHER: max saturation 35% on any color, max lightness 65%, prefer earth tones / dusk / smoky tones / patina. NO neon, no vibrant primaries. If a color reads as 'pop' or 'vibrant', it's too saturated — desaturate again. Plus motion still halved (LERP α 0.05→0.02). Restraint is the goal.

lia_halloran.praise: The warm dusk-black #0a0908 refuses pure void, and the age-driven ascent gives the field a real upward reaching gesture rather than scattered points.
lia_halloran.concern: 102k additively-blended hard square points are exactly the black-with-white-dots cliché I object to — no painterly hand-mark, no blue, the bone-white accumulation just glows.
lia_halloran.directive: Give points soft radial-alpha falloff and tint toward prussian-blue dusk instead of additive bone-white; scale point size by age for painterly variation.

casey_reas.praise: The Aizawa attractor is my ideal substrate — a deterministic ODE, zero per-frame noise, local rules producing organic vascular global form, and the desaturation directive honors restraint.
casey_reas.concern: AdditiveBlending fights that restraint: it builds bright high-contrast hot-spots where orbits stack, and the CCRU captions are literary spectacle bolted onto a quiet rule-system.
casey_reas.directive: Swap AdditiveBlending for NormalBlending at low per-point alpha so density reads as accumulated trace not glow, and drop the CCRU captions.

quayola.praise: The form is literally a point-cloud read from a 320×320 state texture — the digital substrate is right there as material, not hidden.
quayola.concern: The Aizawa tower presents as a complete, healthy continuous organism — no occlusion voids, no torn geometry, nothing admits this is a captured, failing measurement.
quayola.directive: Discard a random fraction of particles per frame so occlusion voids tear the tower, and tint those torn edges cold scanner-blue.

entangled_others.praise: The aging lifecycle — particles wrapping and recycling to the base — reads as genuine more-than-human metabolism, and the vascular Aizawa branching is biology, not decoration.
entangled_others.concern: The CCRU accelerationist captions ('NOTHING HUMAN MAKES IT OUT') re-center the human and its doom-talk over the organism; the rigid uniform 'tower' imposes architecture on a growth.
entangled_others.directive: Vary climb height per-particle by branch speed so growth is uneven, not a uniform tower; biologize or cut the human-doom captions.

tyler_hobbs.praise: The patina/dusk earth palette is curated to this piece, not plug-and-play — the desaturation reads as deliberate oil-painter restraint I respect.
tyler_hobbs.concern: An Aizawa attractor is nothing but overlapping orbits — streams cross chaotically under additive blend, and a single dead-center tower has no asymmetric weight or negative space.
tyler_hobbs.directive: Offset the tower off-center for asymmetric weight, and map age to distinct color blocks—base umber to tip oxide—so density reads as composed regions.
